source_summary: Ink-and-wash Chinese landscape with winter-bare trees, rocky hills, misty distant ridges, and a lower foreground road with ox cart, animals, and small mounted figures. Motifs exclude seals, borders, calligraphy, and paper texture.

motifs.name: upper_floating_bare_branches
motifs.description: Isolate the detached cluster of thin, leafless tree branches near the upper center, appearing like a distant treetop or brushy crown suspended in open space.
must_preserve: light gray-brown wash remnants around the branch mass

motifs.name: left_winter_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the dense grove of bare, dark trees at the left edge, including the interlaced trunks, exposed branches, and lower brush at the base, but not the red seals along the margin.
must_preserve: dark base vegetation and short vertical grass strokes

motifs.name: left_handcart_and_attendant
motifs.description: Isolate the small rustic wheeled handcart or farm cart and the crouched/standing attendant beside it at lower left, keeping the cart wheels and woven frame separate from the surrounding tree grove as much as possible.
must_preserve: compact ink accents at feet and cart base

motifs.name: central_blossom_shrubs_and_rocks
motifs.description: Isolate the central mound of clustered pale flowering shrubs and low rocks below the main trees, with dotted blossoms and tangled roots.
must_preserve: dark accents tucked behind the pale shrub masses

motifs.name: central_twisted_tree_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the main central rocky cliff with twisted bare trees rising from it, including dark foliage patches, exposed roots, vertical rock faces, and the branching silhouette across the center.

motifs.name: right_crag_with_bare_tree
motifs.description: Isolate the right-side craggy outcrop with a bare tree leaning across it, vertical cliff marks, and the dark dotted ridge descending into the foreground.
must_preserve: dark dotted texture along the ridge
vertical ink slashes on cliff face
soft wash transitions around the slope edge

motifs.name: misty_right_mountain_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the pale distant mountain and mist bank on the right half, including the diagonal ridge lines, soft washes, and hazy valley forms behind the foreground crags.
must_preserve: thin contour lines fading into blank space
subtle darker accents at lower ridge base

motifs.name: lower_ox_cart_procession
motifs.description: Isolate the lower foreground procession: two oxen or cattle, the enclosed covered cart with large spoked wheel, small attendant figure, and the ground line beneath them.

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
